title: τ-lag bug-fix replication across TSMC / MediaTek / UMC
bug_description: K1067/K1067b/K1067c used u_prev = r_{t-1} / sqrt(tau[t]) inside the GARCH-MIDAS g update.  The correct form is u_prev = r_{t-1} / sqrt(tau[t-1]), because tau[t-1] is the long-run component observed at time t-1.  Using tau[t] leaks forecast-day exogenous state into the previous day's standardized residual.
final_verdict: UMC event |t| >= 2 after fix → bug is negligible.  K1067b/c monotonicity findings hold.

references: Patton (2011). Volatility forecast comparison. J Econometrics 160.
Harvey et al. (2016). DM t > 3.0 threshold.
